This vertical editorial illustration features a large portrait of a man wearing a black peci cap and a suit, facing right. He occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame. Above him, a horizontal line of stylized water waves separates the lower green section from an orange sky. On the water line, a large, dark, rectangular landmass or barge sits centrally, topped with white crane structures. Two red and white tugboats are visible: one on the left, one on the right.

The top of the image features the word "TEMPO" in large black capital letters, with "MELACAK EPISENTRUM WABAH COVID-19" above it. Below "TEMPO" is "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Below the water line, white text reads "INVESTIGASI JEJAK FULUS MENTERI AGUS". Further down, a block of smaller text begins with "SEBELUM MENJADI MENTERI PERDAGANGAN...". At the bottom, there is a white barcode on the left, a QR code on the right, and center text indicating "30 MARET-5 APRIL 2020", "RP 45.000", and other publishing details. A red border runs down the left edge and along the bottom.
